purpose: Define the evidence needed before any on-track tactical event probability or causal finish effect may be numerically calibrated.

required_separation.pre_event_expected_line: Provider forecast/expected partition before race; never promoted to observed leg-show or on-track state.
required_separation.legshow_observed_line: Direct pre-race observed line/order only after transport and timing provenance are independently proven.
required_separation.on_track_tactical_events: Race-process annotations governed by a separately authorized outcome-aware burned calibration gate if such evidence is ever opened.
required_separation.finish_outcome: Must remain separate from tactical-rate calibration unless a later prespecified causal design explicitly admits it.

quality_requirements.preferred: Independent double annotation or mechanically checkable operational definitions for a prespecified subset.
quality_requirements.agreement: Disagreement rate or inter-annotator agreement must be reported before rate fitting.
quality_requirements.ambiguity: Ambiguous events remain unknown; forced labels prohibited.
quality_requirements.missingness: Unobservable segments are explicit missing data, not negative events.

numeric_rate_admission_rules: Rates must be conditioned on an explicit eligible-event denominator; raw event counts alone are insufficient.
Sampling weights and race inclusion must be fixed without candidate-model performance.
Expected-Line short-window revision diagnostics cannot be substituted for on-track line-cohesion or fragmentation rates.
Successful finishing-technique counts cannot be substituted for unconditional tactic-use rates.
Any outcome-aware calibration sample becomes BURNED and cannot serve as untouched validation.
Small-sample estimates must be represented with uncertainty/ranges rather than a single truth coefficient.
Absolute rates are not admitted until the evidence gate explicitly changes each named tactical quantity from UNIDENTIFIED.
finish_effect_admission_rules: Tactical event frequency evidence does not by itself identify causal finish effects.
Finish effects require a separately prespecified design and may not be estimated from the same sample merely because event annotations exist.
Candidate architectures and coefficients must remain hidden from truth-mechanism calibration.
No real predictive superiority claim follows from a calibrated truth generator without independent validation.
currently_admitted: PRE ordinal tactical evidence from ST/BK and successful technique history
provider Expected Line snapshots with point-in-time provenance
ordinal tactical world families without event probabilities
terminal_rule: Until a separate evidence-admission gate is explicitly opened and satisfied, the Reality truth generator may construct actors and admissible action families but must fail closed before stochastic tactical event-rate execution or finish-order generation.
